title: Returned item and looking for something better made.
text: Returned item and looking for something better made.. Did not fit our small loveseat without riding up in the front and sides. Stitching was also in strange places on the item. It’s definitely not a classy looking sofa cover, it would be ok in a very casual family room I guess. Returned item and looking for something better made.

product_metadata.title: Great Bay Home Modern Velvet Plush Love Seat Slipcover. Strapless One Piece Stretch Loveseat Cover. Love Seat Cover for Living Room. Magnolia Collection Slipcover. (Love Seat, Aqua)
